newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Leader plans Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Leader plans Eurobond issue.

text.p: Malaysian cable maker Leader Universal Holdings Bhd has proposed to issue up to $125 million worth of Euroconvertible bonds to meet the company's immediate needs.

A statement from Leader Universal's bankers on Thursday said the proposed issue would also allow the group to diversify its financing sources and further strengthen its capital base when the bonds are converted into shares.
The seven-year bonds will have a fixed coupon yet to be determined and payable annually in arrears.
